errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states the clockwise order of the slices. The actual order, starting from the blue slice ("услуги"), is: orange ("търговия"), then grey ("производство"), and finally yellow ("друго"). The generated text swaps the positions of the yellow and grey slices.
